title: 🔥市场结构显示同步流动性外流
body: 市场处于全面普跌状态。BTC.D指标为58.6%，7日变化为-0.0%。在BTC价格本周下跌3.2%的背景下，BTC.D维持恒定，说明场内并未发生“币种轮动”避险，而是比特币与山寨币同步面临流动性枯竭。资金正在撤离整个板块。偏空。避险资金去哪了？
body_en: The market is facing a broad sell-off. BTC.D is sitting at 58.6%, with a 7-day change of -0.0%. With BTC down 3.2% this week, the stable dominance indicates that there is no "rotation" into safety. It’s not capital shifting within the market; rather, both Bitcoin and altcoins are facing a simultaneous liquidity drain. Capital is exiting the entire sector. Bearish. Where is the flight to safety heading?
